patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image transitions to a solid dark background, maintaining a large, stylized brand name as a central visual element.
Oversized, bold sans-serif typography is used for the brand name, which also serves as an interactive element in the hero section.
A high-contrast palette of deep navy/dark blue and white is consistently accented by a vibrant coral/orange, particularly for interactive elements and brand highlights.

The hero section features a scroll-triggered transformation where the background image scrolls away, revealing a solid dark background, while the 'O's within the large 'STORYBOARD' text animate their fill color.
Content sections alternate between a deep navy background with white text and a light grey background, providing clear visual separation and rhythm.

technique_notes: The hero section features a scroll-triggered effect where a full-bleed background image scrolls upwards, revealing a solid color background. Concurrently, a large, stylized brand name text element remains fixed, and specific characters within it (the 'O's in 'STORYBOARD') animate their fill color from transparent to a solid accent color as the scroll depth increases.
A sticky navigation bar maintains its position at the top of the viewport, providing persistent access to site navigation.
Content sections utilize a clean, sans-serif typography with high contrast against dark backgrounds, often employing a split layout for text and imagery.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized bold display (~5-6x body) with clean body text and small uppercase labels
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on buttons and cards
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, but a tighter grid for case study cards

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic, scroll-triggered transformation of the oversized 'STORYBOARD' brand name in the hero section, where the 'O's animate to a solid accent color as the background image scrolls away. This creates a memorable and interactive brand introduction.
